# Settings

The engine's settings, in the namespaces reserved for its subsystems (04 §10). A profile or a game scenario may set them; rules read them with `setting(id)`. They are simulation state, stored in the save.

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---------|---------|--------------|
| <a id="actions-idle-wait"></a>`actions.idle_wait` | `1` | Seconds of its own time an entity that nothing gave anything to do idles before it is asked again (03 §5.2). Default 1. |
| <a id="ai-max-minds-per-batch"></a>`ai.max_minds_per_batch` | `256` | How many minds think in one batch; the rest think in the next. |
| <a id="ai-max-steps-per-thought"></a>`ai.max_steps_per_thought` | `16` | How many steps that take no time one thought takes. |
| <a id="ai-max-thoughts-per-tick"></a>`ai.max_thoughts_per_tick` | `4` | How many times one mind thinks in one tick; more wait a millisecond. |
| <a id="combat-launch-at"></a>`combat.launch_at` | `3` | Metres a second: a push at least this fast launches its target as a body in flight; between the two it staggers it. Default 3. |
| <a id="combat-stagger-at"></a>`combat.stagger_at` | `0.5` | Metres a second: a push slower than this moves nothing. Default 0.5. |
| <a id="hit-overkill-factor"></a>`hit.overkill_factor` | `10` | How many times what a whole body could absorb a hit spread over it must carry to destroy it outright (06 §7.4). Default 10. |
| <a id="mind-confidence-halflife"></a>`mind.confidence_halflife` | `60` | Seconds in which a track's confidence halves while its subject is not perceived (15 §7). Default 60. |
| <a id="mind-max-memories"></a>`mind.max_memories` | `32` | The most memories a mind keeps; the least salient are forgotten first (15 §15). Default 32. |
| <a id="mind-max-noted"></a>`mind.max_noted` | `32` | The most noted things a mind keeps (15 §15). Default 32. |
| <a id="mind-max-tracks"></a>`mind.max_tracks` | `64` | The most tracks a mind keeps; the least confident are forgotten first (15 §15). Default 64. |
| <a id="mind-salience-halflife"></a>`mind.salience_halflife` | `600` | Seconds in which a memory's salience halves (15 §7). Default 600. |
| <a id="perception-map-slabs-max"></a>`perception.map_slabs_max` | `1024` | How many slabs of map memory a member of the party keeps, a slab being one storey of one tract; the oldest are forgotten first. Default 1,024. |
| <a id="perception-max-awareness"></a>`perception.max_awareness` | `128` | The most others an observer keeps awareness of; the least aware are forgotten first (15 §15). Default 128. |
| <a id="perception-max-candidates"></a>`perception.max_candidates` | `32` | The most entities one sweep of one sense considers, the nearest first (15 §15). Default 32. |
| <a id="perception-omniscient"></a>`perception.omniscient` | `false` | Whether every event counts as seen by the party, for development (15 §13). Default false. |
| <a id="perception-warm-factor"></a>`perception.warm_factor` | `4` | The multiple of its threshold a signal must reach to be received by an observer simulated in warm detail (15 §14). At least 1. Default 4. |
| <a id="rules-max-call-depth"></a>`rules.max_call_depth` | `32` | How deeply rules may call each other. Default 32. |
| <a id="rules-max-cascade"></a>`rules.max_cascade` | `10000` | The most events one pump may deliver before it stops with `events.cascade_limit` (03 §4.3). Default 10,000. |
| <a id="rules-max-query-cells"></a>`rules.max_query_cells` | `1048576` | The most cells one spatial query may cover; a query over more is refused when it runs, and one whose radius is a constant over the default is a load error (05 §11). Default 1,048,576. |
| <a id="rules-max-queued"></a>`rules.max_queued` | `1000` | The most rules that may be queued before the queue is next emptied. Default 1,000. |
| <a id="rules-max-reactive-rounds"></a>`rules.max_reactive_rounds` | `8` | How many rounds of re-evaluating reactive expressions one pump runs before it leaves the rest stale until the next (05 §7.5). Default 8. |
| <a id="rules-max-steps"></a>`rules.max_steps` | `100000` | The most effects and loop iterations one run may execute. Default 100,000. |
| <a id="rules-max-transitions"></a>`rules.max_transitions` | `1000` | The most phase changes an action may make without time passing before it ends with `engine:transition_limit` (03 §13). Default 1,000. |
| <a id="rules-max-value-depth"></a>`rules.max_value_depth` | `32` | How deeply lists and maps may nest in a value an effect writes. Default 32. |
| <a id="rules-max-value-size"></a>`rules.max_value_size` | `65536` | The most elements of a list or a map, or bytes of a text, an effect may write. Default 65,536. |
| <a id="track-capabilities"></a>`track_capabilities` | `8` | The most observed capabilities one track keeps (15 §15). Default 8. |
